The FloPlast screw-on end cap offers a robust and essential solution for 110mm soil and vent pipes within drainage systems. Manufactured from durable, lightweight uPVC, this cap provides reliable sealing and ensures long-lasting performance. It facilitates crucial access to the soil stack, enabling straightforward testing and maintenance for plumbers and drainage professionals. The screw-on mechanism is easy to install and work with, accommodating high temperature waste discharges and offering a secure connection, making it ideal for both new installations and upgrades across properties. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
